**docs: copy the #962 sixth-reader draft under #976 and verify its roster claims**

Issue #976: the Applied at paragraph of brain/core/anti-patterns/evidence-reader-empty-on-failure.md still said brain-audit.mjs's loadConfig swallowed a config-read failure and was tracked in #962, which PR #969 had already fixed and closed, and it listed approved-label.mjs as an ALLOW reader when governance.approvedLabel is a single string with the ratified fixed fallback 'status:approved'. The #962 draft was COPIED into openspec/changes/issue-976-evidence-reader-roster/ with issue: 976, because the issue-link gate needs an open approved issue; the #962 folder is untouched and stays as the historical record. Every reader the paragraph names was re-derived from source before promotion, and a pre-promotion adversarial review simulated the whole promotion and verdicted PROMOTE-READY. The promoted paragraph matches that simulation verbatim. Known gap left open: #975, loadBrainConfigOrThrow still accepts JSON that parses but is not an object.
